claims.statement: PM-519 was wet clean wall buildup removed showerhead new with seasoning dummy wafers pre-PM recipe 61.58 s baseline 60.0 s target 500.0 A control 493.0 to 507.0 spec 485.0 to 515.0
Earlier PM-114 wet clean showerhead replaced new had thickness slope -0.95 A per lot versus PM-250 slope -0.07 and PM-120 first wafers vs later -8.66 and slope -0.06 and first wafers vs later -0.44
Metrology matching certified 500.0 A reference MET01 reads 500.0 MET02 reads 499.93 difference -0.07 checked 10.0 h ago
Monitor 1 run 1 at 60.0 s measured 497.61 A rate 8.2934 with 3 wafers left
Monitor 4 run 4 at 60.0 s measured 494.48 A rate 8.2413 with 0 wafers left showing lower settled rate than monitor 1

release.summary: Wet clean removed buildup - pre-PM 61.58s would now give 507.07A thick - and new showerhead needs time. Monitors at 60s dropped from 497.61A to 494.48A settled, rate 8.2343 needs 60.72s for 500A. History with same new showerhead thinned -0.95 per lot, so set drift 0.95 and faster lambda 0.4 to track. Metrology offset -0.07 negligible.

release.summary: Wet clean removed buildup (pre-PM 61.58s would now run ~507A thick) and new showerhead installed with 5 dummies seasoning. Monitors at 60s settled near 494A (last three 493.6-494.5A) vs first 497.6A, rate ~8.23 A/s needing 60.72s for 500A. Same showerhead history showed -0.95A/lot thinning for 40 lots, so set drift 0.95 and lambda 0.4 for faster tracking. Metrology offset -0.07A negligible. 60.72s keeps target inside 493-507 control and 485-515 spec.
